lines.label: Change
lines.note: Swapped with Abyssal Voyage}}.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Tahm Kench swallows the target champion for up to 3 seconds, rendering them vanish and lockout, as well as granting them displacement immunity for the duration. Devour can be recast after 1 second, and does so automatically at the end of the duration.

lines.note: Devour will not automatically recast while Tahm Kench is performing Abyssal Dive}}, and will instead do so after he has finished.

lines.label: Change

lines.label: Change
